'''Warp Pack: Emissary''' is the 20th virtual expansion for [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by the [[The Continuing Committee]] on April 11, 2014. The set consists of 6 cards. This set is part of the ''Deep Space Nine Block'' consisting of cards from [[Emissary]], [[Emissary: Supplemental]], [[Warp Pack: Emissary]], [[The Maquis]], and [[The Gamma Quadrant]].

The card numbering system continues after the four virtual preview cards (59P to 62P).
